fact: MRCG's fifteenth press freedom report records the arrest of a Citizens Radio reporter in June 2025, NaTCA's withdrawal of frequencies from Truth Media and G8 Media Group in July 2025, and editor Thomas Dixon's release on bail of NLe 100,000 in August 2025.
title: Sierra Leone's Press Freedom Under Pressure: MRCG Flags Arrests, Assaults and Digital Threats Against Journalists
